findings.text: the durable copy hardcodes the reviewed node's own worktree root and a /tmp scratch path the run deleted, so the reproduction report.md:110-124 promises cannot be run from analysis/ alone and a later reader must rewrite both paths - the same defect appears at analyse.py:19, control.py:24 and plot.py:18.
a dead conditional, ax.set_xlim(-0.7, 3.7) if False else ax.set_xlim(-0.7, 3.7), ships in a stored script and leaves a reader unable to tell whether a different limit was ever intended.

the placebo restriction is built from the five differing confounders rebuildable from one row, while the restricted rate the report leans on at report.md:15 uses eight, so the control does not exercise the procedure it is cited against; the direction of the real restriction, which raises the xhigh rate rather than lowering it, is what keeps the verdict sound.
